description: Check whether a number passes the Luhn (mod 10) algorithm used by card numbers, IMEI numbers and many IDs, and compute the check digit to append. Only the format is checked; nothing is looked up. Use to catch typos in card or ID numbers. Example: number=79927398713. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: validate_luhn
title: Luhn check digit
